name: starlight
description: Astro Starlight docs: .md, .mdx and .mdoc content (Markdoc is experimental upstream) under src/content/docs/, ATX '#' headers, MDX imports (import X from "./_shared.mdx", used as <X />) and Markdoc partials ({% partial file="./_footer.mdoc" /%}) resolved as paths within the project root; .astro/.js/.jsx imports, bare package specifiers (@astrojs/starlight/components) and unimported components — Starlight's built-ins and Markdoc's import-free tags alike — are deliberately skipped. Auto-detected from an astro.config.{mjs,js,ts,mts} that calls the starlight() integration, or a package.json depending on @astrojs/starlight, at or above content_dir.
